name: Umbra (spellbound)
note: Umbra under Mrak's spell: purple glowing eyes, torn cloak. Uses the hero rig; after kneel he is the normal Hearth Knight hero_shadow.
behavior: mini-duel: dash at the hero, attack (shadow projectile = the existing fx_shadow_projectile on attack frame 3). Each light hit stuns briefly; at 0 HP play stunned, then kneel; the spell is broken.

stunned.notes: the spell breaks: purple sparks leave him; his eyes return to frost on frames 2-3

kneel.notes: hold the last frame, then swap to the hero_shadow (Umbra) sprites
